name: When should I consider a short sale consultation?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a short sale consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a short sale consultation if you are facing financial hardship, can no longer afford your mortgage payments, and your home's value is less than what you owe on it. This is a critical preparation step. It's important to act early, ideally before missing multiple mortgage payments or receiving official foreclosure notices, to explore all available options. A consultation with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can help assess your eligibility and explain the potential benefits and drawbacks specific to your circumstances in Miami-Dade or Broward County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a short sale consultation if you are experiencing financial hardship, cannot afford mortgage payments, and your home is underwater. Early consultation helps explore options before foreclosure.
